items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I was about to see Peter Volkow. And Peter on too, I guess I was about to see him.

ctx.x: He was the one man. But I think now, among that bunch that I came along with, I was older than all of these. I was older than any I ever played. And any of those on the picture you ever played? Oh yeah. I was about to see Peter Volkow. And Peter on too, I guess I was about to see him. I was older than all those men. And I often look at that picture and I said, well sir, I'd be older than all. I think because I stopped playing. I don't think they put on my life.
It might have helped, although some, Albert Glenny kept playing until he was quite old, didn't he? Yeah, exactly. I can put this picture back if you like.
